visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A tan and white Corgi wearing a pink collar lies on its back on a white tiled floor, exposing its white belly and paws. The dog's mouth is wide open with its tongue lolling out, looking up with expressive, dark eyes. A human hand enters from the bottom right, petting the dog's chest with rhythmic, affectionate movements. The background is composed of clean tiles and bright, even indoor lighting. (2) A second Corgi with a black collar enters the frame from the top left, nudging its head towards the human's hand to solicit attention. The hand responds by reaching out to scratch the second dog's head and neck while the first dog remains in its playful, supine position. In the background, several cardboard boxes and a ceramic pet food bowl are visible, creating a domestic setting under warm lights. (3) The human hand continues to alternate between both excited dogs, scratching their ears and necks. Both Corgis have their mouths open in wide play-smiles and their ears are perked forward. The setting includes a cluttered background with a green plastic storage crate and various household items on the floor. The camera is held at a high angle, capturing the interaction from the human's perspective. (4) The human, wearing olive green trousers and black sandals, is partially visible at the edge of the frame. The dogs remain highly energetic, with the first dog rolling slightly and the second dog sitting upright, both vying for the hand's affection. The lighting remains consistent and bright throughout the phase, highlighting the soft texture of the dogs' fur and the details of their collars.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male human voice speaks in Mandarin with a playful and friendly tone, asking the dogs "What's wrong? Do you want pets too?". High-pitched, rhythmic barks from one of the dogs punctuate the speech, indicating a high level of arousal and excitement. There is no background music audible in this phase, only the clear acoustics of an indoor room. (2) A sharp, loud bark from a Corgi marks the beginning of this phase. The human's voice remains constant, laughing softly and speaking to the pets with an affectionate, high-pitched cadence. The sound of hands rubbing against the dogs' fur creates a continuous mid-frequency rustling sound, which is layered over the quiet indoor room tone. No BGM is present. (3) A sequence of rapid, staccato barks occurs as the dogs interact and compete for attention. The human says "How about you? I'm coming to you next," maintaining a warm and animated tone with frequent rising intonations. The incidental noise of the dogs' paws clicking on the tiled floor is clearly audible. No BGM accompanies this playful interaction. (4) The audio concludes with more playful barking and the human's voice acknowledging both dogs affectionately. The spectral density is high during the barks, which are sharp and percussive in nature. The human's speech is clear and well-projected, showing positive valence and high dominance as he manages the pets' energy. There is no background music in the mix.
